name: sup-recency-equal-maximals
notes: `W1` and `W2` share the exact same selector (`[]`) but different trees (`tests/t.test.ts` flips red to green between them), so they are mutual `'equal'` under `selectorRelation` -- never `'superset'` -- and neither demotes the other: both stay maximal against current `C` (selector `['src']`), and `baseline.superset_candidates` MUST disclose 2 even though the selector is literally identical (no equal-selector dedupe, spec §5.2 normative). The more recent `W2` wins the recency tie-break. `transitions.out_of_scope` staying undefined is the observational proof: had the stale `W1` won instead, `tests/t.test.ts`'s baseline-red verdict would surface there (it is outside `C`'s narrower selector); `W2` recorded it green, so nothing is disclosed.
